# Factorize

A development environment for your agent: use an authorized API, give a VM scoped access, or react to an Event.

Application: https://app.factorize.sh
MCP (Streamable HTTP + OAuth): https://app.factorize.sh/mcp

Factorize publishes Event occurrences; subscribers decide what to do with them.

## Get started

- [Factorize](https://docs.factorize.sh/): A development environment for your agent.
- [Your first steps](https://docs.factorize.sh/quickstart): Connect your agent and try one small, reversible task.
- [Connect your agent](https://docs.factorize.sh/mcp/overview): Authorize a remote MCP client and control what it may do.

## Work with your agent

- [Use a connected API](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/use-an-api): Discover an authorized integration and make a read-only test request.
- [Give a VM access](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/vm-access): Grant and revoke isolated Factorize access for an existing workload.
- [React to an Event](https://docs.factorize.sh/work/triggers): Publish a test occurrence, verify delivery, and configure real inputs when ready.

## Account integrations

- [AWS](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/aws): Run AWS Code Mode through a dedicated IAM role without giving Factorize an AWS access key.
- [GitHub Container Registry](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/ghcr): Pull and push a GitHub-hosted image from an approved Factorize workload.

## Event sources

- [Event payloads and conditions](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/events): Define payload schemas and filter provider Trigger inputs.
- [GitHub Triggers](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/github): Configure GitHub webhook inputs that publish Event occurrences.
- [ClickUp Triggers](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/clickup): Configure ClickUp webhook inputs that publish Event occurrences.
- [Integration access](https://docs.factorize.sh/integrations/oauth): Connect external services used by Trigger inputs and MCP clients.

## Troubleshooting

- [Connection problems](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/connection): Recover MCP authorization, scopes, and integration access.
- [Event and Trigger troubleshooting](https://docs.factorize.sh/troubleshooting/events): Diagnose rejected inputs, missing occurrences, and subscription updates.

## Reference

- [MCP tool reference](https://docs.factorize.sh/mcp/tools): Event, Trigger, and integration operations available through MCP.
- [Events and Triggers](https://docs.factorize.sh/concepts): Understand Factorize's durable event model.
- [REST API reference](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/reference): How to use the generated API reference.
- [Authentication and scopes](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/authentication): OAuth 2.1, device authorization, and access-token rules.
- [OAuth discovery](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/discovery): Endpoints and metadata for OAuth-aware clients.
- [OpenAPI definition](https://docs.factorize.sh/api/openapi): Download the verified Factorize REST contract.
- [REST operations](https://docs.factorize.sh/openapi.yaml): Complete generated REST schemas and operations

## Self-hosting

- [Optional self-hosting](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/deployment): Deploy your own Factorize instance.
- [Operator configuration](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/configuration): Email, OAuth applications, webhooks, and Worker secrets.
- [Operations](https://docs.factorize.sh/self-hosting/operations): Maintain the Factorize Worker, database, and static application.

## Machine-readable REST reference

- https://docs.factorize.sh/openapi.yaml
- https://docs.factorize.sh/llms-full.txt
